title.narrative: Construction and rehabilitation of water supply and waste water systems and related soft measures to improve water management efficiency

description.narrative: The overall objective of the Action is to improve the living conditions of host communities and Syrian refugees in the South-East of Turkey in terms of access to water and sanitation services.
